paragraphs.text: Senka , called the Stealer of Serets, is a guildless rogue on Ravnica . At one point she was on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals.

Senka somehow managed to evade Dimir detection spells and traps and broke into the Dinrova Building . Dimir officials claimed Senka eluded all safeguards and entered the heavily protected Dinrova basement. She then brazenly exited through the publically accessible lobby carrying a lumpy, moving bundle. She released a Dinrova Horror to ensure her smooth departure past the guards. The horror devoured the Dimir guards, escaped the building, and consumed a passing Orzhov Armored Transport. The transport was later recovered, stripped of all value, and covered in ooze. Meanwhile, Senka had slipped away. Her identity remained a mystery to the Azorius for a while, and only once they had learned her name did they put her on their most wanted list.
